SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 2887
H. Q. Crime Branch Station,
13/11/31.
Date November 12, 1931.
Subject (in full) Further to attached
Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Hunter
Sir,
On November 12th 1931 I interviewed Mr. R. C. Young,
Building Surveyor, P.W.D., and returned the building permit
issued in respect of Nos. 207a and 208a North Thibet Road.
Mr. Young is refunding to the undersigned the Tls. 4.00
paid for same. I therefore suggest that this report be
filed.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
J. Hunter
C.D.I.
D.C. (Crime)

报告
上海公共租界工部局警务处
及特别分部登记处
S. B. D. 2887
总部刑事科，
1931年11月13日。
日期：1931年11月12日。
事由（全文）：关于附件事宜
由刑事侦缉督察亨特（C.D.I. Hunter）撰写并呈报

先生：
1931年11月12日，本人会见了工务局建筑测量师 R. C. Young 先生，并退回了就西藏北路207a号和208a号签发的建筑许可证。Young 先生正向本人退还为此支付的规平银4两。因此，本人建议将此报告归档。

此致
敬礼

J. Hunter
刑事侦缉督察
副督察长（刑事）
11月13日
1931年11月13日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. B. REGISTRY S. B. D. 2887 "A" Division Office Date October 22, 1931）
Subject (in full) attached anonymous letter.
Made by and Forwarded by A/D.D.O.A.
Sir,
I beg to report with reference to attached, on the
19-9-31 acting on instructions from Mr.iers D.). (Crime)
the undersigned interviewed Mr. J.E. Needham, Deputy
Commissioner, P.W.D. and Mr. R.J. Young, Building Surveyor
P.W.D. when it was arranged to fill in a bogus permit to
effect alterations to shop fronts at Nos. 207a and 208a North
Thibet Road. In order to carry out the investigations the
occupants of the above address had to be put wise with regards
to P.W.D. inspect visiting the premises. A contractor was
then approached and instructed to visit the P.W.D. Building
Surveyor's office and obtain the necessary permit, and on
producing chops and a blue print, showing the alterations
required, the permit was duly passed to Mr. R.J. Young and
issued to the contractor on the 21-10-31, on payment of $4.00
which Mr. Young has promised to refund. The contractor visited
the P.W.D. office on six different occasions and interviewed
Kuh Yung King( ) the suspected clerk and requested that
he use his influence to expedite the issue of the permit,
and although the clerk Kuh Yung King was given every opportunity
to ask for squeeze he never once even suggested it, the permit
was issued in the usual way and within a reasonable time limit.
Mr. R.J. Young has been informed by the undersigned
as to the result of police investigations. The $4.00 will be
collected from him and the permit returned.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
（签名）
D.C. (Crime).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处及特别分部登记处 S. B. D. 2887 “A”分区办事处 日期：1931年10月22日）
事由（全文）：所附匿名信。
由代理分区助理总监（A/D.D.O.A.）撰写并呈报

先生：
谨就附件事项报告如下：1931年9月19日，根据刑事科 D.). 先生的指示，本人会见了工务局副总监 J.E. Needham 先生和工务局建筑测量师 R.J. Young 先生，当时商定填写一份虚假许可证，以便对西藏北路207a号和208a号的店面进行改建。为了开展调查，必须让上述地址的住户知晓工务局视察员将前往该处视察。随后接触了一名承包商，并指示其前往工务局建筑测量师办公室获取必要的许可证；在出示印章和显示所需改建内容的蓝图后，许可证经 R.J. Young 先生正式审核，并于1931年10月21日在支付4.00美元后签发给了承包商，Young 先生已承诺退还该笔款项。该承包商先后六次前往工务局办公室，会见了涉嫌职员顾永庆（Kuh Yung King，音译），并请其利用影响力加快许可证的签发。尽管给予该职员顾永庆索取贿赂的各种机会，但他从未甚至暗示过此类要求，许可证是按常规方式并在合理时限内签发的。

本人已将警方调查结果告知 R.J. Young 先生。将从他那里收回4.00美元，并收回许可证。

此致
敬礼

（签名）
副督察长（刑事）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 2887
13. 11. 31.

Anonymous letter dated 18/10/31.

To Commissioner
Dear Sir,

This is to report to you that your
employee, Mr. Koh (now occupying Mr
Mos' position) is now undertaking to
facilitate the issue of permits for a
consideration and daily expends this
income in brothels or wine & gambling.
I think an investigation into this matter
would render benefit to the business
world.

Yours truly
Anonymous

上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央及特别分部登记处
S. B. D. 2887
1931年11月13日。

日期为1931年10月18日的匿名信。

致总监

尊敬的先生：

特此向您报告，您的雇员顾先生（Koh，现接替 Mos 先生的职位）目前正通过收取好处费来便利许可证的签发，并将此收入每日挥霍于妓院、酒馆及赌场。

本人认为，对此事进行调查将使商界受益。

此致
敬礼

匿名
